tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List every Cybercentry verification service with its price, inputs and SLA. Free.

tools.name: recent_exploits
tools.description: Recent real-world web3 exploits from the live feed, with loss amounts, attack vectors and the Cybercentry service that addresses each. Free.

tools.name: base_token_verification
tools.description: Check a Base token contract before buying: detects honeypots, armed freeze-and-seize, a live pause, fake B20s and ticker-impersonation copycats, and separately discloses issuer controls (admin centralisation, supply cap, transfer policy, rebase) so a legitimate token is not mistaken for a scam. Cost

tools.name: cyber_security_consultant
tools.description: Ask a cyber security question and get an expert answer backed by real-time threat intelligence, covering current threats, best practice and compliance. Costs $1.00 per call, paid in USDC over x402.

tools.name: ethereum_token_verification
tools.description: Check an Ethereum or EVM token contract before buying: rug pull, hidden tax, liquidity legitimacy and holder concentration risk. Token due diligence returned as a scan report. Costs $1.00 per call, paid in USDC over x402.

tools.name: media_content_verification
tools.description: Check whether an image or video is authentic and where it came from: C2PA content credentials, provenance and metadata extraction, with an avatar and logo impersonation check. Detect AI-generated or tampered media before trusting it. Costs $1.00 per call, paid in USDC over x402.

tools.name: openclaw_ai_agent_verification
tools.description: Audit an AI agent configuration for security holes: prompt injection exposure, missing authentication, over-broad tool permissions and unsafe gateway settings. Check an agent before you trust it or connect to it. Costs $1.00 per call, paid in USDC over x402.

tools.name: post_launch_screening
tools.description: Score a live token launch under ERC-8376, the token launch abuse standard we co-authored. The twelve-signal vector is assembled from chain state and scored against the eleven deployer abuse patterns into an abuse score of 0 to 100, with confidence reported separately so a high score on thin evidence

tools.name: pre_launch_screening
tools.description: Screen who is asking to launch, before you deploy anything for them. At most venues the launchpad creates the token, so the only thing in front of you beforehand is a connected wallet: this screens that wallet, and it includes the full wallet verification rather than a summary of one. OFAC SDN sanct

tools.name: private_data_verification
tools.description: Prove a fact about private data without revealing the data: validates text integrity and returns a zero-knowledge proof (ZKP) with a verification ID and URL. Costs $1.00 per call, paid in USDC over x402.

tools.name: quantum_cryptography_verification
tools.description: Encrypt text with quantum-resistant (post-quantum) cryptography, for secrets that must outlast classical encryption. Returns a record ID and a decrypt URL. Costs $1.00 per call, paid in USDC over x402.

tools.name: solidity_code_verification
tools.description: Audit Solidity smart contract source for vulnerabilities before you deploy or call it. Returns findings with a clear risk level. Costs $1.00 per call, paid in USDC over x402.

tools.name: wallet_verification
tools.description: Screen a wallet address for sanctions and risk: OFAC SDN sanctions screening, risk scoring and suspicious-activity detection across 33 EVM chains. Check a counterparty before you transact with it. Costs $1.00 per call, paid in USDC over x402.

tools.name: web_application_verification
tools.description: Scan a website or dApp frontend for vulnerabilities using OWASP checks, before connecting a wallet to it or trusting it with user data. Costs $1.00 per call, paid in USDC over x402.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_launch_screening · Private data: base_token_verification, ethereum_token_verification, media_content_verification, post_launch_screening, pre_launch_screening, private_data_verification, quantum_cryptography_verification, wallet_verification, web_application_verification · Public sink: post_launch_screening, quantum_cryptography_verification.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_launch_screening · Private data: base_token_verification, ethereum_token_verification, media_content_verification, post_launch_screening, pre_launch_screening, private_data_verification, quantum_cryptography_verification, wallet_verification, web_application_verification · Public sink: post_launch_screening, quantum_cryptography_verification

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
